get.description:
Effect names with their tunable params and defaults, read off the signatures.

Lets the UI build the right controls per effect (a direction dial for
spatial effects, an origin picker for ripple) without hardcoding a table.

put.description:
Save strip placements to config.yaml and rebuild geometry live.

DMX addressing is untouched, so this does not restart the Art-Net nodes —
the rig keeps running while you drag strips around. A running spatial
effect is restarted so it picks up the new positions.

delete.description: Drop all placements and fall back to the auto-arranged default.

get.description: Return the full current config as JSON (for the config app).

put.description: Validate a new config, write it to config.yaml, and reload the controller live.

post.description: Re-read config.yaml from disk and restart the controller.

get.description: List host network interfaces with IPv4 addresses, for the source_ip picker.

post.description: Set a strip pixel by pixel — one half red and one half blue, say.
Solo one strip so you can see which physical fixture it is.

delete.description: Leave identify mode and restore the stage as it was.

post.description: Nudge the live field — used by the UI to drag the spot around.

get.description:
Render the running field to a small grid.

Lets the UI show the actual picture the LEDs are sampling, rather than
inferring it from the strip colours.

PixelsRequest.title: PixelsRequest
PixelsRequest.description:
Per-pixel colours, pixel 1 first.

Short lists repeat across the strip, so `[[255,0,0],[0,0,255]]` alternates
and a two-element list on an 8-pixel strip gives a 4/4 split... use
`[[255,0,0]]*4 + [[0,0,255]]*4` for one half red, one half blue.
